per_proof_checks.mathematical_check: Checks closed isometric E restriction of the F driver and free group, intertwining of Young sums by uniqueness, endpoint/difference norm compression and measurable separable-path Young dependence. The exact given-noise endpoint, amplitude, one mask, horizon and smaller common admissible exponent are matched before applying the named tube radial envelope. The added B=1 clock reduction is explicitly verified against the supplied Cameron-mean setup. The compact-perturbation endpoint norm lower bound uses only the admitted compact-endpoint subclause of symplectic-free, not its free symplectic invariance subclause.

At fixed delta, public original-noise pullback domination and vanishing residual, full-path Gaussian comparison, fixed-g F extension and square-exponential tails justify Young convergence with uniform integrability of flow moments because 1/theta<2. Ordinary source primitive is identified by indicator approximation, fixed-width point bounds and countable row/state continuity. The exact substitution lambda-prime=delta*lambda computes temporal width tau/delta and g² Gamma amplitude, with both source heat widths and cutoff maximum preserved. All bounds are fixed-delta; no growing-radius uniform source convergence or exchanged limits is claimed.

Publicly constructs the high Sobolev phase with integer k>d/2+1, bounded strongly continuous free matrix including zero sine quotient, Leibniz multiplier control, factorial Picard bound and uniqueness identifying the E flow. Fourier Cauchy-Schwarz gives continuous displacement and velocity; countable source derivative evaluations and Picard measurability give joint measurability. Distributional first Duhamel component is identified with the continuous scalar Green integral via finite mass/support and absolute Fubini. No point trace at the original low regularity or dimension-three Green density is asserted.

Publicly matches the realized single-source law and both total initial phase components on a causally closed compact cone; plateau distance follows from |x|+t≤R-1. Total free finite propagation is applied before splitting constant and E components. The homogeneous difference iteration has the correct t^(2n)/(2n)! mass and finite sample coefficient, yielding equality without coefficient positivity. Terminal Tonelli plus only unmasked-law stationarity gives an integral of squares, not a squared average, with fixed-parameter events.

Removes source widths first at fixed delta: L2 operator/displacement convergence and the independent canonical single-source point-moment limit pass both sides of the exact cone-square identity. Canonical scaling and the explicit U(t)=V(delta*t), gYfast=sqrt(delta)Y(delta*t) computation yield the law/moment identification at terminal time, preserving mixed/self/empty chains and Green-before-noise ordering. Initial H1 scaling gives the polynomial R^d cost including d=1 negative gradient power; delta log prefactor vanishes, kappa>1 and the bijective parameter change give the rate inequality. Direct zero covariance free-flow Fourier bounds and cone identity are checked separately. No source/time exchange, spatial Jacobian at zero or masked-operator stationarity is used.
